greeting: Hi! I'm the @read_wine bot. Here is what I can do; the same commands are in the ≡ menu next to the message field:
command.cancelled: OK, cancelled. Pick the next action from the ≡ menu next to the message field.
help: ℹ️ How it works 1. Add me to your channel as an admin with two rights: Post messages and Edit messages of others. Leave every other right off. 2. Send /new and forward me the giveaway post, or send its link. I add a join button under it. 3. When the giveaway ends, I draw the winners and send them to you for review: ✅ means the winner is subscribed to your channel, ⚠️ means not. Replace a winner with 🔄, then publish the results under the post. 🤝 Giveaway with a partner channel? Its owner adds me as an admin with every right off. That's enough for me to check that the winners are subscribed there too.
giveaway.prompt: Starting a new giveaway. Forward me the channel post it should run on, or send its link.
giveaway.ask_end_date: When does the giveaway end? Send the date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-10-25, or tap the button.
giveaway.ask_end_time: At what time does it end, Kyiv time? Send HH:MM or tap the button.
giveaway.ask_winners: How many winners? Send a number from 1 to 98 or tap the button.
giveaway.ask_button_text: What should the join button say? Send up to 64 characters or tap the button.
giveaway.invalid_date: That's not a date in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-10-25.
giveaway.date_in_past: That date has already passed. Send today's date or a later one.
giveaway.invalid_time: That's not a time in HH:MM format, for example 19:00.
giveaway.time_in_past: That time has already passed. Send a later one.
giveaway.invalid_winners: Send a whole number from 1 to 98.
giveaway.invalid_button_text: The button text must be 1 to 64 characters long.
giveaway.summary:
Check the giveaway:

Post: %[1]s
Ends: %[2]s (Kyiv time)
Winners: %[3]d
Button: %[4]s
giveaway.created: Done! The post now has a join button.
giveaway.exists: Your giveaway is already on this post. To change it, send /edit.
giveaway.taken: Another admin's giveaway is already on this post.
giveaway.not_admin: Only admins of the channel can start a giveaway on its posts.
giveaway.no_rights: I can't run a giveaway in this channel. Make me a channel admin with the “Post messages” and “Edit messages of others” rights, then send /new again.
giveaway.failed: Something went wrong. Send /new and start again.
giveaway.join_failed: Couldn't sign you up. Please try again.
draw.results_one: 🎉 The giveaway is over! The winner:
draw.no_winners: The giveaway is over. Nobody took part, so there are no winners.
edit.prompt: Forward me the channel post your giveaway is on, or send its link.
edit.not_found: There is no giveaway on this post.
edit.not_yours: Another admin created this giveaway, so only they can change it.
edit.finished: This giveaway is finished and can no longer be changed.
edit.not_admin: Only channel admins can change a giveaway.
edit.no_rights: I can't edit this post. Make me a channel admin with the “Edit messages of others” right and try again.
edit.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
edit.menu: %[1]s 📄 Post: %[2]s %[12]s 📅 Date: %[3]s %[8]s ⏰ Time: %[4]s (Kyiv time) %[9]s 🏆 Winners: %[5]d %[10]s 👥 Participants: %[6]d 🔘 Button: %[7]s %[11]s
edit.status_published: The giveaway is running. Changes apply at once.
edit.status_cancelled: The giveaway is cancelled: the post has no button, and its participants are kept.
edit.status_draft: This is a draft: the post has no button yet. Check the fields, then publish the giveaway.
edit.ask_cancel: Cancel the giveaway? The button disappears from the post and the participants are kept, so you can publish it again.
edit.cancelled: The giveaway is cancelled and its button is removed from the post.
edit.ask_finish: Finish the giveaway now? Within a minute the bot picks the winners and sends them to the creator to check before publishing. This cannot be undone.
edit.finishing: The giveaway is finishing: within a minute the creator gets the winners to check and publish.
edit.restored: The giveaway is published again and its button is back on the post.
edit.end_passed: The end time has passed. Change the date or time, then publish the giveaway.
edit.date_time_in_past: On that date the end time has already passed. Change the end time first, or pick a later date.
edit.list_gone_note: ⚠️ A post was deleted. Its participants are kept: tap [✏️], then [✏️] next to “📄 Post”, and send a new post of the same channel.
edit.move_prompt: Forward me the new post from the same channel, or send its link. The participants stay with the giveaway.
edit.move_other_channel: This post is from another channel. Send a post from the giveaway's channel.
edit.move_same: The giveaway is already on this post.
edit.move_taken: This post already has a giveaway. Send another post.
edit.moved: The giveaway is on the new post now. Its participants are kept.
edit.post_gone: This post no longer exists. Move the giveaway to another post: tap [✏️] next to “📄 Post” in its menu.
review.results: 🏁 The giveaway is over. Check the winners: 🔄 N replaces winner N with another participant. When everyone qualifies, publish the results.
review.no_winners: 🏁 The giveaway is over and has no winners. Publish the results to tell the channel.
review.ask_reroll: Replace winner %[1]d, %[2]s? Another participant takes the place, and %[2]s can no longer win this giveaway.
review.ask_publish: Publish the results under the post? This cannot be undone, and the winners can no longer be replaced.
review.published: The results are published under the post.
review.publish_failed: I couldn't post the results in the channel. Make sure I'm a channel admin with the “Post messages” right, then tap “📣 Publish results” again.
review.published_partly: Only part of the results reached the channel: Telegram refused the rest. Post the missing winners in the channel by hand.
review.ask_skip: Close the giveaway without results? Nothing is posted in the channel. This cannot be undone.
review.skipped: The giveaway is closed without results in the channel.
review.not_admin: Only admins of the giveaway's channel can review its results.
review.not_pending: This giveaway is already closed: its results are published or skipped.
review.waiting: 🏁 The giveaway is over. Its results wait for your review in /list.
review.channels: ✅ subscribed to the giveaway's channel, ⚠️ not subscribed, ❔ couldn't check. Channels: %[1]s
edit.list_results: - %[1]s Post [📣 Review results] · results not published
